_README.purpose: Interface texts for worksheets rendered by js/worksheet.js (toolbar, headers, footers, level names).
_README.instructions: One block per language. Texts from back to of were reviewed by partners (copied from ws03); the rest are machine-translated and need a check. The "index" block belongs to worksheets.html, the list of every worksheet.
